operation.en: There's an SMR in China which is scheduled to start commercial operation in the next 12 months, and others being built in Canada and America.
operation.zh: 中国有一座 SMR 计划在未来12个月内投入商业运行，加拿大和美国也在建造其他反应堆。

opening.en: It is in the final stages of opening a nuclear storage site deep underground that will be able to safely store nuclear waste for 100,000 years.
opening.zh: 它在地下深处建造的核废料处置库已处于最后开放阶段，该处置库将能安全储存核废料长达10万年。

opposite.en: A fusion reaction has the opposite problem: it is incredibly difficult to keep going.
opposite.zh: 聚变反应面临的问题则截然相反：维持聚变反应极其困难。

opportunity.en: When you don’t have much meat, butter, eggs, sugar, you don’t really have opportunities to create tasty dishes.
opportunity.zh: 当你没有多少肉、黄油、鸡蛋、糖时，你真的没有机会创造美味的菜肴。

opinion.en: A well-made sticky toffee pudding is perhaps the best dessert in the world, in my opinion.
opinion.zh: 在我看来，一个制作精良的太妃糖布丁也许是世界上最好的甜点。
